_help: On-screen health display. mem/hud.mem is GENERATED from this file + the PNGs.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_hud_mem.py
4 pages of 32x64 words (y 0-31, x 0-63): 0 heart full, 1 heart empty, 2 boss bar frame, 3 boss bar fill. The game draws everything at exactly 2x.
Player = hearts (one per HP). Boss = health bar (fill is clipped to hp/max_hp). Positions: HUD_* in rtl/params.vh.
heart_full = background + heart + border layers; heart_empty = background + border. The bar fill sits 14 source pixels right of the frame start (info.txt in the Hearts pack).
Any missing / unreadable file -> that page falls back to a plain drawn heart / bar with a WARNING (the game always builds).
